notes.title: Update Version 1.3
notes.content:
G'day, Version 1.3 adds the following changes.

[list]
    [*] New models and extra environmental items added
    [*] Changes to level layouts
    [*] Cleaner UI with dialogue events.
    [*] General bug fixes.
[/list]

If you have any issues with 1.3 open a new discussion in the steam discussion tab and we'll address it as soon as we can.

Have a good one.

tags.feature: [*] New models and extra environmental items added
